summary: When the local activity executor thread pool is fully exhausted by blocked activities, subsequently scheduled workflows that attempt to execute local activities hang permanently with no automatic recovery mechanism.
userImpact: Workflows hang permanently and become unrecoverable when local activity thread pool is exhausted, requiring manual reset or explicit timeout configuration.
rootCause: Local activities are dispatched to an in-process thread pool. When all threads are occupied by blocked activities, newly dispatched activities are queued but never executed because the workflow coroutine parks on CompletablePromiseImpl.get() waiting for a result that never arrives. The workflow task never times out or fails, so it is never retried.
workaround: Set scheduleToCloseTimeout on LocalActivityOptions. The SDK tracks this deadline from scheduling time, independently of thread pool availability.
keyQuote: Local activities are dispatched to an in-process thread pool. If all threads are occupied by blocked activities, newly dispatched local activities are queued but never executed.
